newsitem.title: BURUNDI: 1,500 died in Burundi refugee camp - missionaries.
newsitem.headline: 1,500 died in Burundi refugee camp - missionaries.

text.p: An estimated 1,500 people have died of disease in a camp for displaced people in northern Burundi over the last six months, missionaries in the area say.
Between seven and ten people each day were dying from dysentery, malaria and typhoid, a Roman Catholic nun told reporters who visited the camp at Bugenyuzi, Karuzi province, last weekend.
"The camp lacks facilities to cope with such diseases; it has no latrines and there are few medical supplies," she added.
The camp is situated in an area where fighting has been taking place between the Burundi army and Hutu rebels, making it difficult for aid workers to supply food and medicines.
Only one aid organisation, the Belgian Medecins sans Frontieres (MSF - Doctors without Borders), is operating in the five camps in the area.
The trade embargo imposed against Burundi in July by neighbouring African states -- in protest against the military coup there -- has contributed to the problems of the camps, the missionaries said.
There is widespread malnutrition, especially among children in the camps, they said.
